# Zenvi tools

<!-- Generated by packages/engine/scripts/gen-tools-doc.ts from @zenvi/engine/tools. Do not edit by hand. -->

One tool catalog for every Zenvi surface: the Zenvi Assistant in the web editor, the local MCP server (`zenvi mcp`), the Zenvi Cloud remote MCP server, and the CLI. 85 tools: the 73 contract-3 tools of Zenvi desktop (zenvi-core develop `2c99ed2c0fd5`; the inspect and speech tools develop does not have yet from `b63c39be7c3c`; same names, arguments and receipts) and 12 direct tools for coding agents.

Every call returns a contract-3 receipt (`{contract: 3, status, tool, summary, clips, …, undoSteps}`); a failure's summary starts with `Error:`, and a surface limitation says `Error: <tool> is not available in this Zenvi surface: …` (do not retry). One call is at most one undo step.

## Where tools work

| Surface | Host | Works | Partial | Not available |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Web editor (Zenvi Assistant, command palette) | `apps/editor/src/features/editor/assistant/host.ts` | 65 | 6 | 14 |
| CLI and local MCP server (zenvi, zenvi mcp) | `packages/render-node/src/host/node-host.ts` | 63 | 5 | 17 |
| Zenvi Cloud remote MCP server (ChatGPT, Claude.ai) | `packages/cloud/src/mcp/engine.ts` | 57 | 7 | 21 |
| Zenvi desktop | zenvi-core | 73 | 0 | 12 (direct tools are web-only) |

Availability follows each tool's required host capabilities and the host methods it calls at run time; the hosts are described in `SURFACE_PROFILES` (packages/engine/src/tools/availability.ts). Capabilities a session may lack (signed out of Zenvi, no WebCodecs export) are noted per tool.

- **Web editor (Zenvi Assistant, command palette)**: media, player, ui, exporter, frames, backend, storage; methods media.importUrl, media.pickFiles, media.writeGenerated, ui.openExportDialog; only sometimes: exporter (browsers with WebCodecs export), backend (signed in to Zenvi).
- **CLI and local MCP server (zenvi, zenvi mcp)**: media, exporter, frames, audio, storage, backend; methods media.importPath, media.listPaths, media.importUrl, media.writeGenerated, storage.open, storage.readText, storage.writeText; only sometimes: backend (signed in with zenvi login).
- **Zenvi Cloud remote MCP server (ChatGPT, Claude.ai)**: media, frames, storage, assets, audio, backend; methods media.importUrl, media.writeGenerated, storage.readText, storage.writeText; only sometimes: frames (when the render worker is configured), media (when ffprobe is available), assets (when title templates are bundled), audio (when ffmpeg is available), backend (after the person allows the connector); hides 13 local-app tools.

## Tools

### get_project_info_tool

**Read project info**. Return project profile, fps, duration, and scale.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. read-only.

Availability: editor yes; cli yes; cloud yes; desktop yes.

No arguments.

### list_files_tool

**List project media**. List media-bin files (paths, ids) — not timeline positions.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. read-only.

Availability: editor yes; cli yes; cloud yes; desktop yes.

No arguments.

### list_clips_tool

**List clips**. List timeline clips with source_start/end, summary_preview, and occurrence_hint when duplicates exist.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. read-only.

Availability: editor yes; cli yes; cloud yes; desktop yes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `layer` | string |  | Optional layer_number or UI track filter. |
| `detail_level` | string |  | Sent by the assistant backend; ignored here. |

**Save project**. Save the project to file_path (e.g.

### watch_clip_tool

**Load and play clip**. Play a clip in the editor preview: seek to a timeline clip (timeline_clip_id or query) and start playback.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. edits. Needs: player.

Availability: editor partial (file_path needs local file access); cli — (needs playback); cloud — (hidden: belongs to a local app); desktop yes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file_path` | string |  | Media path to import, place and play. |
| `query` | string |  | Describe the timeline clip to play. |
| `file_id` | string |  | Media-bin file to play (added to the timeline when it is not there yet). |
| `timeline_clip_id` | string |  | Timeline clip to play. |

### watch_clip_window_tool

**Watch clip window**. Vision-check whether a query is actually visible in a window of a placed clip.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. read-only, open world. Needs: frames, backend.

Availability: editor yes (only when signed in to Zenvi); cli yes (only when signed in with zenvi login); cloud yes (only when when the render worker is configured and after the person allows the connector); desktop yes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string |  | What should be on screen in the window. |
| `start` | string \| number |  | Window start, source seconds (12, 12.5 or 0:12). Give start and end together, or neither to watch the best search match. |
| `end` | string \| number |  | Window end, source seconds. |
| `timeline_clip_id` | string |  | Timeline clip id (from list_clips_tool, get_timeline_state_tool or an earlier receipt). |
| `clip_query` | string |  | Describe the clip instead of passing an id: file name, subject, or words from its summary. Narrow it with track, occurrence or position_near. |
| `track` | string |  | Track: layer_number (preferred), track_id, the exact label, or ui_track counted from the bottom (1 = bottom). |
| `occurrence` | string \| number |  | 1-based pick when the query matches the same source several times (0 = best match). |
| `position_near` | string \| number \| null |  | Timeline seconds; only clips that span this time match. |

### delete_from_timeline_tool

**Delete from timeline**. Delete from the timeline: one clip placement, or an entire track.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. edits, destructive.

Availability: editor yes; cli yes; cloud yes; desktop yes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `timeline_clip_id` | string |  | Timeline clip id (from list_clips_tool, get_timeline_state_tool or an earlier receipt). |
| `clip_query` | string |  | Describe the clip instead of passing an id: file name, subject, or words from its summary. Narrow it with track, occurrence or position_near. |
| `track` | string |  | Track: layer_number (preferred), track_id, the exact label, or ui_track counted from the bottom (1 = bottom). |
| `scope` | "auto" \| "clip" \| "track" |  | auto (default): a clip id/query deletes one placement, a bare track clears the track. clip / track force the branch. (default "auto") |
| `occurrence` | string |  | 1-based pick when the query matches the same source several times (0 = best match). (default "0") |
| `position_near` | string \| number \| null |  | Timeline seconds; only clips that span this time match. |
| `include_transitions` | boolean |  | Track scope only: also delete transitions on the track (default true). (default true) |

### set_clip_volume_tool

**Set clip volume**. Set one timeline clip's audio level, over the whole clip or one time window.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. edits, destructive.

Availability: editor yes; cli yes; cloud yes; desktop yes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `timeline_clip_id` | string |  | Timeline clip id (from list_clips_tool, get_timeline_state_tool or an earlier receipt). |
| `clip_query` | string |  | Describe the clip instead of passing an id: file name, subject, or words from its summary. Narrow it with track, occurrence or position_near. |
| `track` | string |  | Track: layer_number (preferred), track_id, the exact label, or ui_track counted from the bottom (1 = bottom). |
| `occurrence` | string \| number |  | 1-based pick when the query matches the same source several times (0 = best match). (default "0") |
| `level_db` | string \| number |  | Gain in dB (e.g. -6). |
| `level` | string \| number |  | Linear gain 0..1. |
| `start_seconds` | string \| number |  | Window start, TIMELINE seconds. Omit start/end for the whole clip. |
| `end_seconds` | string \| number |  | Window end, TIMELINE seconds. |
| `fade_ms` | string \| number |  | Ramp length at each window edge, milliseconds (default 150). (default "150") |
| `mode` | string |  | 'replace' (default) or another handler mode. (default "replace") |
| `volume` | string \| number |  | Alias for level (a string ending in 'dB' is read as level_db). |
| `gain` | string \| number |  | Alias for level. |
| `db` | string \| number |  | Alias for level_db. |

### duck_under_speech_tool

**Duck music under speech**. Duck music/SFX beds under speech with volume keyframes, restoring them in the gaps.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. edits, destructive.

Availability: editor partial (without audio analysis only indexed transcript cues find the speech); cli yes; cloud yes; desktop yes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bed_clip_ids` | string |  | Comma-separated music/SFX clip ids to duck (default: every bed overlapping speech). |
| `bed_query` | string |  | Describe the bed clip instead of passing ids. |
| `bed_track` | string |  | Only duck beds on this track. |
| `speech_clip_ids` | string |  | 'auto' (default: clips with transcript cues) or comma-separated speech clip ids. (default "auto") |
| `duck_db` | string \| number |  | 'auto' (default: per bed, from measured levels) or dB of attenuation, e.g. -12. (default "auto") |
| `attack_ms` | string \| number |  | Ramp down before speech, ms (default 150). (default "150") |
| `release_ms` | string \| number |  | Ramp back up after speech, ms (default 400). (default "400") |
| `pad_before_ms` | string \| number |  | Start ducking this long before speech, ms (default 200). (default "200") |

## Divergences from the desktop

Deliberate differences from the zenvi-core handlers:

- **add_title_tool**: The text also replaces every line whose placeholder matches the first line's. Reflection templates (Bar_1, the default) draw a mirrored copy first; the desktop's `_set_svg_text` (agent_tools/titles.py:32) fills only that copy and blanks the real line, so its titles render upside down.
- **add_clip_to_timeline_tool**: Appending (no position_seconds) butts the clip against the last clip on the track. The desktop places it at `last_end + _one_frame` (tool_handlers.py:2726), leaving a one-frame black/silent gap.
- **add_clip_to_timeline_tool and the tools that place through it**: A host that cannot watch frames (no frame rendering or no Zenvi backend) counts as "not watched": a duration-only trim of a full video is refused instead of placing the first N seconds, and the result never says "(watched)". The desktop's watch falls back softly and places the window.
- **watch (add_clip_to_timeline_tool, slice_clip_at_best_match_tool, search_clip_scenes_tool, watch_clip_window_tool)**: Up to 12 frames rendered by the host; no ffmpeg scene-cut detection (shot cuts are always reported as none) and no near-duplicate frame dedupe (watch_window.py extract_watch_window).
- **apply_transition_tool**: clip2 defaults to the next clip on clip1's track instead of `Error: clip2_id is required` (tool_handlers.py:6645); no transition_name means fade (the desktop took the first file in its transitions folder).
- **reindex_project_file_tool**: "Already indexed" reads the current `ai_metadata.index` block (legacy `twelvelabs` as fallback); the desktop reads only `twelvelabs` (tool_handlers.py:7344). Re-uploading for indexing is not available on the web.
- **list_markers_tool**: A marker's `label` (set by the web editor and add_marker_tool) is shown as its name; desktop markers have none (tool_handlers.py:1252).
- **add_title_tool / add_captions_tool**: Templates are the bundled catalog, read by basename only (the desktop joined a bare template name into its titles folder unchecked, agent_tools/titles.py:81); an absolute .svg path is read through the host's storage.
- **get_transcript_tool, export_captions_tool, add_captions_tool**: Transcripts come from the indexed `ai_metadata.transcript_cues`; word timings inside a cue are estimated by character count (`transcriptionSource: "index_cues"`, `wordTiming: "estimated"`). The desktop runs on-device ASR.
- **remove_silence_tool**: Speech windows come from the desktop's energy VAD run on the host's RMS envelope (AudioHost.analyzeAudio), not from on-device VAD models.
- **web-only arguments**: Hosts without a playhead or local file paths, and the CLI, need a few arguments the desktop's TOOL_SCHEMAS do not have (scripts/tool-schema-overlay.json `web_extra_props`): add_marker_tool position_seconds/label/text (the desktop adds at the playhead), add_track_tool label, save_project_tool path, set_clip_volume_tool volume/gain/db, watch_clip_tool file_id/timeline_clip_id, import_stock_media_tool position_seconds/track/duration_seconds/start_seconds (place the import). Every argument the desktop accepts is accepted unchanged.
- **split_file_add_clip_tool**: require_visual_match reads true/false; the desktop's `bool(...)` treats the string "false" as true (tool_handlers.py:2370).
- **wait_for_editor_job_tool (desktop MCP extra, #237)**: Not in the catalog: tool calls here run to completion inside the call, so there is never a detached editor job; the name gets the standard not-available refusal.
- **argument coercion**: As zenvi-core normalize_args, plus numbers/booleans become strings for string-only properties (MCP clients send typed JSON).
- **summary previews**: `…` is written as U+2026; the desktop's file had the mojibake `ΓÇª` (ai_metadata_utils.build_summary_preview).
